title: A generic coefficient chart for a strict localization
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $Y$ a finite-type $K$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ a geometric point with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point]. Write $y=s(\operatorname{closedPoint}\Omega)$ and $B=\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y,s}$ for the canonical strict-henselization ring [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. There exist an affine open $U$ containing $y$, a separably closed extension $L/K$ [def-kun-separably-closed] with $\operatorname{trdeg}_K L=\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(y)$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree], [def-weil-residue-field], a commutative domain $R$, compatible $R$- and $\operatorname{Frac}(R)$-algebra structures on $L$ with $L/\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ algebraic, and ring maps $r:R\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$, $a:\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)\to B$, $h:L\to B$. The ring $B$ is nonzero. The composite $\operatorname{Spec}B\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Spec}a}\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)\cong U\hookrightarrow Y$ is the canonical structural morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. The composites $R\xrightarrow r\Gamma(U)\xrightarrow a B$ and $K\to\Gamma(U)\xrightarrow a B$ agree with $R\to L\xrightarrow h B$ and $K\to L\xrightarrow h B$, respectively. Here $\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ is the field of fractions, and algebraic means every element satisfies a nonzero polynomial.

proof.text: A separable algebraic field extension L/F is ind-etale. Lift its residue embedding L into E through the henselian ring B using the henselian-colimit lifting theorem. The zero prime of F pulls back from both chosen primes because the field maps are injective. The resulting F-algebra map gives both scalar equations.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_strictLocal_coefficient_chart
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [Y.Over (Spec (.of K))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))]
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ U : Y.Opens, s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) ∈ U ∧
      ∃ hU : IsAffineOpen U,
      ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra K L) (_ : IsSepClosed L),
        Algebra.trdeg K L =
          @Algebra.trdeg K (Y.residueField (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) _ _
            (((Y ↘ Spec (.of K)).residueFieldAlgebraMap
              (s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))).toAlgebra) ∧
        ∃ (R : Type u) (_ : CommRing R) (_ : IsDomain R)
          (_ : Algebra R L) (_ : Algebra (FractionRing R) L)
          (_ : IsScalarTower R (FractionRing R) L)
          (_ : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (FractionRing R) L)
          (r : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤))
          (a : Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤) ⟶ strictHenselizationRing s)
          (h : L →+* strictHenselizationRing s),
          Nontrivial (strictHenselizationRing s) ∧
          Spec.map a ≫ (@Scheme.isoSpec U.toScheme hU).inv ≫ U.ι =
            strictHenselizationStructuralMap s ∧
          r ≫ a = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R L) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom h ∧
          (ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv ≫ (U.ι ≫ (Y ↘ Spec (.of K))).appTop ≫ a =
            CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom h
